marketing_description: The DeWALT DCLE34520GB Cordless 5-Spot Green Line Laser features a self-leveling mechanism for accurate setup, a 5-spot cross line laser for precise layout tasks, and green beam technology for maximum visibility. It has a working range of 330 ft with the detector and 280 ft without, and an accuracy of +/-1/8 in at 30 ft. The laser is powered by a 20 V battery and has a 1/4-20 and 5/8-11 thread size.
